This proposal outlines the development of an open-source R package for converting or constructing Likert items from vectors or data frames, particularly from non-standard data structures. The proposed package eliminates fragmented, manual workarounds for non-standard data structures by introducing a reproducible workflow that mitigates data manipulation risks. 
Operating on a development model of 10 hours per week, the project features a 15-week timeline and a budget of USD 8,500. The timeline is divided into a three-week inception phase; a ten-week coding and testing phase, and initial CRAN submission with concurrent sensitization workshop; and a final two-week phase for incorporating community feedback and project closure. The budget funds 150 hours of core development labor at USD 50 per hour, documentation hosting, and a workshop for faculty and students at the Federal University of Technology, Minna, Nigeria. Upon completion, the package and its continuous updates will be maintained publicly in GitHub and CRAN repositories.
